valuation_pctile.display_en: Valuation cheapness percentile (0–1, higher = cheaper vs peers)

undervalued_state.display_en: Undervalued — composite multiples in cheapest decile vs universe

overvalued_state.display_en: Overvalued — composite multiples in most expensive decile vs universe

insider_power_state.display_en: Insider Power (0–100) — quality-weighted Form-4 open-market trades (role × size × recency); 50 = neutral

insider_buy.display_en: Insider Buy signal — fires when Insider Power ≥ 60 (net buying on quality-weighted basis)

insider_sell.display_en: Insider Sell signal — fires when Insider Power ≤ 40 (net selling on quality-weighted basis)

ichimoku_tk_cross_up.display_en: Ichimoku — Bullish TK Cross (Tenkan crosses above Kijun)

ichimoku_tk_cross_down.display_en: Ichimoku — Bearish TK Cross (Tenkan crosses below Kijun)

ichimoku_cloud_breakout_up.display_en: Ichimoku — Cloud Breakout Up (Price crosses above Kumo)

ichimoku_cloud_breakdown.display_en: Ichimoku — Cloud Breakdown (Price crosses below Kumo)

rsi_stack_curl_up.display_en: RSI Stack (7/14/21) — All Three Curling Up

rsi_stack_curl_down.display_en: RSI Stack (7/14/21) — All Three Curling Down

rsi_stack_oversold.display_en: RSI Stack (7/14/21) — All Three at or Below 30

rsi_stack_overbought.display_en: RSI Stack (7/14/21) — All Three at or Above 80 (reference band)

bb_upper_rejection.display_en: Bollinger Upper Band Rejection (Wick above, Close below)

bb_lower_reclaim.display_en: Bollinger Lower Band Reclaim (Wick below, Close above)

bb_band_walk_up.display_en: Bollinger Band Walk Up (Close above upper band ≥ 3 of last 5 bars)

bb_band_walk_down.display_en: Bollinger Band Walk Down (Close below lower band ≥ 3 of last 5 bars)

adx_ignite_up.display_en: ADX Trend Ignition — Bullish (ADX crosses above 25 while price rising)

adx_ignite_dn.display_en: ADX Trend Ignition — Bearish (ADX crosses above 25 while price falling)

adx_trending.display_en: ADX Trending (ADX ≥ 25 and rising — strong, accelerating trend)

adx_weak.display_en: ADX Weak Trend (ADX < 20 — market ranging, no directional conviction)

aroon_cross_up.display_en: Aroon Bullish Cross (recent highs dominating — uptrend beginning)

aroon_cross_dn.display_en: Aroon Bearish Cross (recent lows dominating — downtrend beginning)

aroon_up_strong.display_en: Aroon Strong Uptrend (recent highs near current bar, lows far away)

aroon_dn_strong.display_en: Aroon Strong Downtrend (recent lows near current bar, highs far away)

vi_cross_up.display_en: Vortex Bullish Cross (VI+ above VI- with separation — upward momentum)

vi_cross_dn.display_en: Vortex Bearish Cross (VI- above VI+ with separation — downward momentum)

elder_bear_flip_up.display_en: Elder Ray Bullish Setup (bear power negative but improving, price trend up)

elder_bull_flip_dn.display_en: Elder Ray Bearish Setup (bull power positive but falling, price trend down)

elder_bulls_dominant.display_en: Elder Ray Bulls Dominant (bull power positive, bear power near zero)

elder_bears_dominant.display_en: Elder Ray Bears Dominant (bear power negative, bull power near zero)

vhf_trend_regime.display_en: Trending Regime by Efficiency (VHF above median)

donch_break_up.display_en: Donchian Channel Upside Breakout (20-day high exceeded)

donch_break_dn.display_en: Donchian Channel Downside Breakdown (20-day low breached)

donch_fail_up.display_en: Failed Upside Breakout (Price retreats below channel within 5 bars)

donch_fail_dn.display_en: Failed Downside Breakdown (Price recovers above channel within 5 bars)

donch_width_expand.display_en: Wide Channel (Donchian width in top 20% of trailing year)

nr7_setup.display_en: NR7 Coiling Pattern Active (Narrowest range in 7 bars, within last 3)

range_expand_up.display_en: Upside Range Expansion (True range > 2×ATR, strong close)

range_expand_dn.display_en: Downside Range Expansion (True range > 2×ATR, weak close)

cmf_zero_up.display_en: Money Flow turns positive (CMF crosses above zero)

cmf_zero_dn.display_en: Money Flow turns negative (CMF crosses below zero)

cmf_pos_persist.display_en: Sustained buying pressure (CMF above +0.05 for 10+ bars)

cmf_neg_persist.display_en: Sustained selling pressure (CMF below -0.05 for 10+ bars)

obv_slope_up.display_en: Volume backing the move up (OBV rising over 20 days)

obv_slope_dn.display_en: Volume backing the move down (OBV falling over 20 days)

obv_break_up.display_en: OBV breaks to new 60-day high (accumulation surge)

obv_break_dn.display_en: OBV breaks to new 60-day low (distribution surge)

rvol_spike.display_en: Volume surge (relative volume doubles its 20-day average)

rvol_dryup.display_en: Volume drying up (5-day average below 60% of normal)

mfi_os_exit.display_en: Oversold money flow recovering (MFI crosses back above 20)

mfi_ob_exit.display_en: Overbought money flow retreating (MFI crosses back below 80)

mfi_50_up.display_en: Money flow momentum turns bullish (MFI crosses above 50)

mfi_50_dn.display_en: Money flow momentum turns bearish (MFI crosses below 50)

kama_cross_up.display_en: Price crosses above adaptive moving average in trending market

kama_cross_dn.display_en: Price crosses below adaptive moving average in trending market

kama_slope_up.display_en: Adaptive moving average rising in trending market

kama_slope_dn.display_en: Adaptive moving average falling in trending market

er_efficient.display_en: Market moving efficiently — trend-following conditions present

st_flip_up.display_en: Trend turns bullish — price breaks above resistance band

st_flip_dn.display_en: Trend turns bearish — price breaks below support band

st_bull_state.display_en: Price above trend support — bullish regime

st_bear_state.display_en: Price below trend resistance — bearish regime

st_pullback_hold.display_en: Price pulls back to trend support then recovers — continuation setup

crsi_os_entry.display_en: Connors RSI deep oversold arrival (crosses below 10)

crsi_os_exit.display_en: Connors RSI oversold exit (crosses back above 10)

crsi_ob_exit.display_en: Connors RSI overbought exit (crosses back below 90)

sprm_zero_up.display_en: Spearman trend turns positive (smoothed rank correlation crosses above zero)

sprm_zero_dn.display_en: Spearman trend turns negative (smoothed rank correlation crosses below zero)

sprm_strong_up.display_en: Spearman strong uptrend (raw rank correlation above 80)

sprm_strong_dn.display_en: Spearman strong downtrend (raw rank correlation below -80)

ui_calm.display_en: Low Drawdown Stress (Ulcer Index below 25th percentile)

ui_stressed.display_en: Elevated Drawdown Stress (Ulcer Index above 75th percentile)

ui_spike.display_en: Drawdown Stress Spike (Ulcer Index doubles in 21 bars, above 5)

ui_recovery.display_en: Drawdown Stress Easing (Ulcer Index crosses below median after stress period)

hvr_compress.display_en: Volatility Compression (short-window vol well below long-window vol)

hvr_expand_event.display_en: Volatility Expansion Breakout (short-window vol crosses above long-window vol)

mass_bulge.display_en: Mass Index Bulge Reversal (range expansion then contraction setup)

mom_accel_up.display_en: Momentum Acceleration Up (3-month crosses above 6-month, both improving)

mom_decel_dn.display_en: Momentum Deceleration Down (3-month crosses below 6-month, both weakening)

rs_repair.display_en: Relative Strength Recovery (stock outpaces benchmark over 3 months)

rs_deteriorate.display_en: Relative Strength Deterioration (stock falls behind benchmark over 3 months)

rs_new_high.display_en: Relative Strength at 6-Month High (stock/benchmark ratio at new peak)

rs_new_low.display_en: Relative Strength at 6-Month Low (stock/benchmark ratio at new trough)

bbt_zero_up.display_en: BBTrend Crosses Above Zero (channel expanding in favor of buyers)

bbt_zero_dn.display_en: BBTrend Crosses Below Zero (channel expanding in favor of sellers)

ib_setup.display_en: Inside Bar — price range compressed within prior bar

ob_expansion.display_en: Outside Bar — price range expands beyond prior bar on both sides

obib_coil.display_en: Outside-Inside Bar Coil — outside bar followed by inside bar compression

triple_ib_coil.display_en: Three Consecutive Inside Bars — prolonged compression coil

strat_212_bull.display_en: Bullish 2-1-2 Continuation — higher high bar, inside bar, upside break

strat_212_bear.display_en: Bearish 2-1-2 Continuation — lower low bar, inside bar, downside break

strat_rev_bull.display_en: Bullish 2-1-2 Reversal — lower low bar, inside bar, upside break

strat_rev_bear.display_en: Bearish 2-1-2 Reversal — higher high bar, inside bar, downside break

strat_312_bull.display_en: Bullish 3-1-2 — outside bar, inside bar coil, upside break

strat_312_bear.display_en: Bearish 3-1-2 — outside bar, inside bar coil, downside break

fractal_low_confirm.display_en: Fractal Low Confirmed (swing low locked in)

fractal_high_confirm.display_en: Fractal High Confirmed (swing high locked in)

swing_uptrend.display_en: Swing Uptrend (higher highs and higher lows)

swing_downtrend.display_en: Swing Downtrend (lower lows and lower highs)

fractal_break_up.display_en: Fractal High Break (close rises above confirmed swing high)

fractal_break_dn.display_en: Fractal Low Break (close falls below confirmed swing low)

kst_cross_up.display_en: KST crosses above signal line (negative territory)

kst_cross_dn.display_en: KST crosses below signal line (positive territory)

tsi_cross_up.display_en: True Strength Index crosses above signal (below zero)

tsi_cross_dn.display_en: True Strength Index crosses below signal (above zero)

coppock_turn_up.display_en: Coppock curve turns up from a trough (below zero)

uo_os_exit.display_en: Ultimate Oscillator exits oversold zone (crosses above 30)

uo_ob_exit.display_en: Ultimate Oscillator exits overbought zone (crosses below 70)

fisher_cross_up.display_en: Fisher Transform crosses above prior bar (below -1)

fisher_cross_dn.display_en: Fisher Transform crosses below prior bar (above +1)

qqe_cross_up.display_en: QQE smoothed RSI crosses above adaptive band (below 50)

qqe_cross_dn.display_en: QQE smoothed RSI crosses below adaptive band (above 50)

stc_turn_up.display_en: Schaff Trend Cycle crosses above 25 (bullish turn)

stc_turn_dn.display_en: Schaff Trend Cycle crosses below 75 (bearish turn)

fvg_bull_form.display_en: Bullish price gap forms (3-candle imbalance zone)

fvg_bear_form.display_en: Bearish price gap forms (3-candle imbalance zone)

fvg_bull_fill.display_en: Bullish gap zone filled (price returns to imbalance area)

fvg_bear_fill.display_en: Bearish gap zone filled (price returns to imbalance area)

price_reclaims_avwap_earnings.display_en: Price reclaims AVWAP from earnings-proxy anchor (quarter's top-volume session)

price_loses_avwap_earnings.display_en: Price loses AVWAP from earnings-proxy anchor (quarter's top-volume session)

poc_retest_hold.display_en: POC retest holds (price defends the point of control)

poc_retest_fail.display_en: POC retest fails (rejected at the point of control)

golden_star_st_7_35.display_en: Golden Star (7/35) — three-entity cross with price gate

golden_star_st_21_100.display_en: Golden Star (21/100) — three-entity cross with price gate

golden_star_lt_50_200.display_en: Golden Star (50/200) — three-entity cross with price gate

death_star_st_7_35.display_en: Death Star (7/35) — bearish three-entity cross with price gate

death_star_st_21_100.display_en: Death Star (21/100) — bearish three-entity cross with price gate

death_star_lt_50_200.display_en: Death Star (50/200) — bearish three-entity cross with price gate

new_golden_star.display_en: New Golden Star — freshly fired Golden Star (7/35), age ≤ 1 trading day
